biw_news.title: Bugatti Restores One-Off Veyron Featuring Hand-Crafted Polished Aluminum Bodywork
biw_news.summary: Bugatti has completed a comprehensive structural and surface restoration of a one-off Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse, showcasing master-level sheet metal finishing and lightweight aluminum body panel preservation.

biw_news.title: Restored Bugatti Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse Highlights Exquisite Aluminum Panel Craftsmanship
biw_news.summary: The meticulous factory restoration of this mirror-polished aluminum supercar demonstrates advanced care and joining maintenance for exotic lightweight metallic exterior structures.

biw_news.title: Made-In-India Suzuki eVitara Achieves Four-Star Safety Rating in Japan NCAP Evaluation
biw_news.summary: The Japan-spec Suzuki eVitara successfully underwent rigorous collision safety and structural deformation assessments under the 2026 JNCAP protocols, validating its body-in-white crashworthiness.

biw_news.title: Subaru Debuts High-Performance Electric Platform Featuring Integrated Lightweight Structural Hardware
biw_news.summary: Subaru's new 510-hp electric prototype highlights significant chassis engineering advancements, utilizing optimized dual-motor layouts and lightweight hardware integration to shape future skateboard platforms.

biw_news.title: GM Restructures EV Manufacturing Footprint by Closing Brownstown Battery Assembly Plant
biw_news.summary: General Motors is shifting its advanced manufacturing strategy by closing specific battery production facilities and repurposing structural assembly lines in response to shifting market demand.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Deploys Over-The-Air Battery Management Modifications for ID.4 Structural Enclosures
biw_news.summary: Volkswagen is issuing software limits via OTA updates to manage thermal parameters within the ID.4 battery pack structural trays as part of a comprehensive safety recall.
